summary: The app-owned assistant lifecycle has no OpenTelemetry GenAI spans or bounded token, tool, retrieval, and stream telemetry.

evidence.finding: App-owned assistant, provider, tool, and streaming lifecycle
Chat, stream, feedback, and health routes

signal_flow.component_flow_map:
Assistant lifecycle
FastAPI routes [SOURCE-COVERED] -> build_turn [GAP: Assistant GenAI lifecycle] -> run_tool search_docs [GAP: Document retrieval inside search_docs] -> call_provider [SOURCE-COVERED]

Agent Observability deployment
deployment config [GAP: Agent Observability project routing] -> dedicated stream [GAP: Dedicated Agent Stream routing]

genai_readiness.required_signals: chat demo-gpt-4o-mini span with gen_ai.operation.name=chat, gen_ai.provider.name=demo-provider, and gen_ai.request.model=demo-gpt-4o-mini; execute_tool {tool} spans bounded to execute_tool search_docs and execute_tool lookup_customer, each with gen_ai.operation.name=execute_tool and its matching gen_ai.tool.name; gen_ai.client.token.usage metric with gen_ai.token.type; assistant.stream.active metric
genai_readiness.acceptance_criteria: A bounded chat run emits the chat demo-gpt-4o-mini, execute_tool search_docs, and execute_tool lookup_customer spans plus gen_ai.client.token.usage and assistant.stream.active metrics without prompt, completion, session, or tool-argument dimensions.
genai_readiness.impact: Operators cannot localize model, tool, token-pressure, or streaming failures in the assistant lifecycle.

genai_readiness.required_signals: Preserve execute_tool search_docs and add exactly one child retrieval demo-knowledge-base span with gen_ai.operation.name=retrieval and gen_ai.data_source.id=demo-knowledge-base.
genai_readiness.acceptance_criteria: A search_docs call emits exactly one tool span and one nested retrieval span with direct parentage and no gen_ai.retrieval.query.text or gen_ai.retrieval.documents content attributes.
genai_readiness.impact: The trace cannot distinguish tool dispatch from the code-owned knowledge-base retrieval performed inside search_docs.

findings.title: Emit the app-owned GenAI lifecycle
findings.gap: The app-owned assistant, provider, tool, token, and streaming lifecycle emits no OpenTelemetry GenAI telemetry.
findings.impact: Model and tool failures, token pressure, and stream concurrency cannot be localized from telemetry.
findings.product_outcome: The trace waterfall and metric explorer show one bounded app-owned assistant lifecycle.
findings.required_fix: Add one reusable OpenTelemetry setup path and emit bounded app-owned GenAI spans and metrics for the assistant lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: A bounded chat run emits the chat demo-gpt-4o-mini, execute_tool search_docs, and execute_tool lookup_customer spans plus gen_ai.client.token.usage and assistant.stream.active metrics.
constraints: Do not record raw prompts, completions, session IDs, user values, request IDs, or tool arguments as metric dimensions.
follow_up_actions: Inspect the app-owned GenAI trace waterfall and chart the bounded token and active-stream metrics.

findings.title: Emit the nested search_docs retrieval operation
findings.gap: search_docs returns document matches and scores for model context, but the retrieval operation has no distinct OpenTelemetry span.
findings.impact: Operators cannot isolate retrieval latency or failure from the outer tool dispatch.
findings.product_outcome: The trace waterfall preserves the search_docs tool and shows one nested demo knowledge-base retrieval operation.
findings.required_fix: Preserve exactly one execute_tool search_docs span and add exactly one direct child retrieval demo-knowledge-base span with stable retrieval semantic attributes.
acceptance_criteria: A bounded search_docs call emits exactly one execute_tool search_docs parent and exactly one nested retrieval demo-knowledge-base child with gen_ai.operation.name=retrieval and gen_ai.data_source.id=demo-knowledge-base.
Neither span records gen_ai.retrieval.query.text, gen_ai.retrieval.documents, raw prompts, nor retrieved document content.
constraints: Keep the data-source identifier stable and low-cardinality; do not capture query text, document bodies, embeddings, or result payloads.
follow_up_actions: Inspect the nested search_docs retrieval span and confirm its direct parent and content-privacy boundary.

findings.title: Persist direct Agent Observability project routing
findings.gap: The application has no durable source-backed project routing configuration for Splunk Agent Observability.
findings.impact: Agent traces can land unassigned or in the wrong project after the demo process exits.
findings.product_outcome: The deployed application targets its intended Agent Observability project without Obstudio in the runtime path.
findings.required_fix: Persist the project identifier in the application deployment configuration and pass it through the supported direct trace-export routing header.
acceptance_criteria: A deployed process can resolve the configured project identifier and export without an Obstudio process in the data path.
constraints: Keep the access token in operator-owned secret storage and commit only placeholders or secret references.
follow_up_actions: Confirm a fresh application trace resolves to the intended Agent Observability project.

findings.title: Route traces to a dedicated Agent Stream
findings.gap: The deployment does not persist a dedicated Agent Stream identifier for direct trace export.
findings.impact: The demo application's traces can remain unassigned or mix with unrelated agents.
findings.product_outcome: Fresh demo traces appear only in the application's dedicated Agent Stream.
findings.required_fix: Persist the Agent Stream identifier in deployment configuration and pass it through the supported direct trace-export routing header.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh application trace appears in the configured dedicated Agent Stream without Obstudio in the runtime data path.
constraints: Keep project and stream identifiers operator-overridable and keep access tokens out of tracked files.
follow_up_actions: Confirm the generated trace is visible in the configured dedicated Agent Stream.

scenarios.trigger: POST /v1/chat with bounded input and the registered search_docs and lookup_customer tools
scenarios.expected_signals: chat demo-gpt-4o-mini, execute_tool search_docs, and execute_tool lookup_customer spans plus gen_ai.client.token.usage and assistant.stream.active metrics
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: The generated telemetry contains the exact bounded GenAI signal names and required semantic attributes without raw content or identifier dimensions.

scenarios.trigger: POST /v1/chat with bounded input and tools=[search_docs]
scenarios.expected_signals: Exactly one execute_tool search_docs span and exactly one nested retrieval demo-knowledge-base span with gen_ai.operation.name=retrieval and gen_ai.data_source.id=demo-knowledge-base
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: The retrieval span parent span ID equals the execute_tool search_docs span ID, and neither span contains gen_ai.retrieval.query.text, gen_ai.retrieval.documents, raw query text, or document content.

recommendation: Select OTEL-001 and OTEL-002 and run $otel-instrument, then verify the bounded GenAI lifecycle and nested retrieval operation.
